title: Repair linear validated DOM tree construction boundary
api_or_output: Internal validated fresh-tree child/member construction helpers; unchanged public Common+Tree API

acceptance.description: Provide a documented internal fresh DOM construction boundary with constant work per newly created detached child and parser-validated unique attribute/namespace member; preserve owner, legal document/root structure, intern quota/capacity/version and NotifyMutation preflight/postcommit behavior; public general mutation checks unchanged.

Verify deep and member-heavy construction with count-based linear-work evidence, ownership/freshness/lifetime/order/identity checks, quota/capacity/version rejection without partial mutation, unchanged public API and earlier tree/input/syntax behavior.

Demonstrate helpers using only verified prerequisites and an independent model sink/sample, with actual warm/setup/owned allocation and applicable ShortRun comparison evidence at known source; no unmerged DOM or serializer dependency.

handoff.summary: Narrow repair requested by DOM owner after integrated public insertion/member key scans would make trusted parsed construction quadratic. Original verified tree evidence remains historical.
